items.heading: The Monthly Amount Needed
items.text: The monthly amount needed to cover essentials, debt obligations, and non-negotiable family commitments.

items.heading: Start with Current Monthly Essentials
items.text: Start with current monthly essentials. Include rent, food, transport, bills, insurance, education costs, and debt.

visuals.title: Key ideas behind The Monthly Amount Needed

visuals.heading: Add Near

items.heading: Add Near
items.text: Add near-certain responsibilities. Family support, upcoming childcare, relocation pressure, or regular dependents should be visible now.

items.heading: Add a Realistic Quality
items.text: Add a realistic quality-of-life buffer. Health, learning, emergency margin, and a reasonable lifestyle matter. Do not plan only for bare survival.

items.heading: Convert to Annual Spend
items.text: Convert to annual spend. This is the number that makes bigger long-term planning clearer.
